Name: Slave machines of Stardew Valley(Unofficial update)
Author: nbv158
Description:
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=5]﻿[/size][u][b][size=5]When reporting bugs, please attach the game log or a screenshot containing the error information. This will help me better resolve these issu[/size][size=4]es.[/size]

[/b][font=quote-cjk-patch, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, Open Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif][size=5][b]在报告错误时，请附上游戏报告或者包含错误信息的图片，这能帮助我更好的解决问题[/b][/size][/font][/u][/color][/quote][b]

[color=#ff0000][size=4][u]I have obtained permission from the original author, MortaliB.[/u][/size][/color][/b][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]This mod will be available until [/b][/size][size=4][b]MortaliB[/b][/size][/color][size=4][b][color=#ff0000][u] either tells me to take it down or updates the original mod.[/u][/color]
[/b][/size][color=#f1f1f1]
[/color][color=#f1f1f1]This is an unofficial update of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10405]Slave machines of Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ by MortaliB, who okayed inofficial updates of their mods - if you like this mod go over there and endorse it.

[/color]The mod will add 21 big craftable machines. For animated images go to the original mod and take a look.

I have made some technical changes to the original mod:
1. Consolidated the three different types of machines from the original files into a single mod.  
2. I was unable to add the original mod's product, the "Golden Egg," to the current mod due to what appears to be a technical limitation.  
3. Added translation files and Chinese translations.  
4. Adjusted the playback speed of animations.  
5. Added crafting recipes to the game—you can now obtain the crafting recipes from the start.
[quote][size=4]If you experience any problem or bug, contact with us in the "Posts" or "Bugs" section[/size]

[i][b][size=4]If you get offended by this type of content, please close this window and don't disturb anyone. Thank you.[/size][/b][/i][/quote]
[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1.Download and extract this mod and the required Mods.
2.Put the extracted Mods into the \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder.
3.Launch the game and enjoy.

[b][size=4][color=#ff0000][u]我已获得原作者MortaliB的许可。本模组将持续可用，直至MortaliB要求下架或更新原版模组。[/u][/color]
[/size][/b]
这是对MortaliB原创模组[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10405]Slave machines of Stardew Valley[/url]﻿的非官方更新版本——原作者已认可对其模组进行非官方更新。如果您喜欢本模组，请前往原模组页面给予支持。

本模组将新增21种大型可制作机器。动态效果图请参阅原版模组页面。
我对原版模组进行了以下技术性调整：
1. 将原版三种不同类型的机器整合至同一模组
2. 因技术限制无法将原模组的"金蛋"产物添加至当前版本
3. 新增翻译文件及中文翻译
4. 调整了动画播放速度
5. 已将制作配方添加至游戏，开局即可获得配方

[quote][size=4]若遇到任何问题或错误，请在"讨论区"或"错误反馈"板块联系我们

[b][i]若此类内容使您感到不适，请直接关闭本页面，勿打扰他人。感谢配合。[/i][/b][/size][/quote]
[b][size=3]安装说明[/size][/b]
1. 下载并解压本模组及必需依赖模组
2. 将解压后的模组文件夹放入 \Stardew Valley\mods\ 路径
3. 启动游戏即可体验
